units: <cite ref="Chullin 8b:7">Ḥull. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>לכי חָיְימָא</he> when it (the knife) gets warm; v. infra.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 12b:12">M. Kat. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מיא דא׳ וכ׳</he> water which a gentile cook had warmed.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 153a:2">Sabb. 153ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ באספידא דהתם וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. <he>א׳ מר … דאנא</he>, Ms. O. <he>א׳ לי</he>) arouse the feelings of the people when delivering my funeral address, for I (my soul) shall be present.

<cite ref="Shabbat 153a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>הא דמַחֲמוּ ליה וחאים</he> Ms. M. (Rashi Ms. <he>וחָיֵים</he>; ed. <he>ואחים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) in the one case (that of the righteous man) they speak warmly of him, and one becomes warm &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 153a">Ib.</cite> <he>מאן א׳ הספ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>חאים</he>, corr. acc.) who will arouse mourning for thee?
